description:
Wire format for $skillname prompt expansion, shared by nac-core (crates/nac-core/src/commands.rs) and the web frontend (crates/nac-server/web/src/app/lib/format.ts). An expanded prompt is {raw}{separator}{blocks}
{close} where each block is one <skill_content name="...">...</skill_content> rendering and blocks are joined by a single 
. Collapse truncates at the last separator, but only when the message ends with 
{close} AND the region between the last separator and that final newline is one or more well-formed blocks joined by single 
's. A well-formed block starts with the literal '<skill_content name="', has a non-empty name free of quotes and angle brackets up to the next '"', then '>', and ends at the first '</skill_content>'. Consumers: Rust test invoked_skills_wire_format_matches_the_shared_fixture in commands.rs (via env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR") + ../../fixtures), vitest suite in format.test.ts (JSON import six ../ up from crates/nac-server/web/src/app/lib). Every collapse vector must stay true under this strictened collapse: expansion vectors use well-formed blocks, and no-collapse vectors must keep not collapsing.
